params.body:
Twice today a hand could add a file but not take one away: two copies of a measurement landed at the wrong path and had to be removed by the operator, and a rename was a person's job.

A file change with `delete: true` becomes a tree entry with a null sha, which is how GitHub's tree API deletes. A deletion carries no content (refused otherwise) and digests as a deletion, so it cannot pass for a write of nothing. `go test ./...` green, gofmt clean.

After the merge: tag `v0.16.0`, then the pin in `startup.sh` and `rehearse.sh upgrade`. The workbench client learns `--delete <path>` in the same step.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: A push may remove a file
